title: Svatantrya blind Sanskrit eval (50)
description:
Fifty held-out Sanskrit passages used to benchmark translation candidates for svatantrya.net. Inputs only: no reference English is included.

Licence: composite. Each passage comes from a named edition in the site trace corpus (mostly GRETIL, which carries CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 where stated). Non-commercial evaluation use only; do not redistribute. Dataset is private and is pulled only by our own kernels. Selection policy and scoring rubric: https://svatantrya.net/data/eval/
